props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The uncontrolled value of the item(s) that should be initially expanded.

To render a controlled accordion, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description:
The controlled value of the item(s) that should be expanded.

To render an uncontrolled accordion, use the `defaultValue` prop instead.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: hiddenUntilFound
props.description:
Allows the browser's built-in page search to find and expand the panel contents.

Overrides the `keepMounted` prop and uses `hidden="until-found"`
to hide the element without removing it from the DOM.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Whether to keep the element in the DOM while the panel is closed.
This prop is ignored when `hiddenUntilFound` is used.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus.

This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Event handler called when an accordion item is expanded or collapsed.
Provides the new value as an argument.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether multiple items can be open at the same time.

props.name: orientation
props.description:
Deprecated following the [APG guidance update](https://github.com/w3c/aria-practices/pull/3434)
to remove roving focus.

This prop no longer affects keyboard focus behavior.

props.name: render
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
